Widgets API ¶

The Widgets API lets you create and list widgets. Base URL: https://api.example.com/v1.

Authentication

Send your key in the X-Api-Key header.
Keys never expire.

List widgets

curl https://api.example.com/v1/widgets \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $KEY"

Query parameters

NameTypeDescription
limitintegerMax items (1-100)
colorstringFilter by color | name

Errors

  • 401 - missing key
  • 429 - rate limited
    • Retry after Retry-After seconds
  1. First
  2. Second

Widgets are eventually consistent.

color
One of red, green, blue.
